visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a high-angle close-up of a large white ceramic bowl filled with a vibrant orange-red ramen broth, topped with an extremely generous pile of fresh, bright green chopped cilantro. A white porcelain spoon is nestled on the left side of the bowl, partially submerged in the broth. The background is a dark, wooden table in a dimly lit indoor restaurant setting with warm, focused lighting highlighting the textures of the food. (2) The camera shifts slightly as a pair of chopsticks or a spoon (partially visible) begins to mix the ingredients, causing the cilantro to submerge into the broth and revealing thick, pale yellow noodles and bean sprouts underneath. Steam rises softly from the hot dish, adding a sense of heat and freshness to the visual texture of the meal. (3) A close-up shot captures the chopsticks lifting a large bundle of steaming yellow noodles from the rich, spicy-looking soup. The noodles glisten with the orange oil of the broth, and small bits of green cilantro are interspersed throughout the lift. The lighting creates a high contrast between the bright noodles and the dark, out-of-focus restaurant background. (4) The focus transitions to a white spoon holding a single, thick piece of braised chashu pork. The meat is square-cut, showing distinct layers of fat and lean meat with a caramelized, dark brown exterior and a tender, pinkish-white interior. The glistening surface of the pork suggests it is succulent and well-cooked. (5) The final phase cuts to an outdoor exterior shot of the restaurant at night. A large, dark sign with gold Japanese lettering "鬼金棒" is prominently displayed above a sliding door entrance. Several people, wearing casual street clothes, are seen standing in a line or congregating near the entrance under the glow of warm artificial street and shop lights, indicating a popular urban location.
